manifest.title: Parked
manifest.author: Korpit <admin@korpit.net>
manifest.description:
A lightweight domain parking app for Cloudron.

Displays a branded landing page for each domain parked on your Cloudron instance. Supports multiple secondary domains (configured via the Cloudron admin), each with its own customisable title, logo image, and blurb — set via a simple JSON config file stored in persistent app data.

Designed to be as lean as possible: static nginx serving, no database, no runtime framework.
manifest.tagline: Park and brand your unused domains

releaseNotes: Version 0.2.1: Add /vhosts configuration viewer endpoint and redirect non-existing paths to root
